source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: Chapter 12 ki exercise (PDF 276-279) hal ke saath; numerical jawab kitab ke jawabon se check kiye gaye.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 12 (Nuclear and Particle Physics) ki exercise hai, kitab ki tarteeb mein, hal ke saath. Har MCQ ke saath sahi jawab aur wajah hai; short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab (poore number wale) hain; numerical problems qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Jahan zaroorat hai, "Wazahat" box mein aasan alfaaz mein samjhaya gaya hai.
Multiple Choice Questions (kai jawabon mein se sahi chunein)

blocks.prompt:
12.1 Which one of the following is the fundamental particle:
(In mein se fundamental (bunyadi) particle kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fundamental particle ki koi andaruni banawat nahi hoti. Electron lepton hai jo fundamental hai; proton aur neutron teen quarks se, aur meson ek quark aur ek antiquark se bane hain (Section 12.5).

blocks.prompt:
12.2 The first discovered anti-particle is:
(Sab se pehle daryaft hone wala anti-particle kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Antielectron (positron) sab se pehla daryaft hone wala anti-particle hai, jo Anderson ne 1932 mein cloud chamber mein dekha; anti-proton 1955 mein mila (Section 12.3).

blocks.prompt:
12.3 Which one of the following pair of particles creates annihilation:
(In mein se particles ka kaun sa joda annihilation (fana ho kar energy banna) karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Annihilation tab hota hai jab particle apne hi anti-particle se mile: e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ.

blocks.prompt:
12.4 The strong nuclear force between the two particles is mediated by:
(Do particles ke darmiyan strong nuclear force kis ke zariye muntaqil hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Chapter (12.7, 12.11) ke mutabiq strong nuclear force gluons naam ke field particles muntaqil karte hain; photon electromagnetic force aur graviton gravity le jate hain. (Purane Yukawa model mein do nucleons ke darmiyan force ko mesons (pions) ke tabadle se samjhaya jata tha; yeh chapter se bahar hai.)

blocks.prompt:
12.5 Which one of the following forces interacts between two particles through photons:
(In mein se kaun si force do particles ke darmiyan photons ke zariye amal karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photons electromagnetic field ke quanta hain; charged particles photons ka tabadla karte hain (Section 12.11).

blocks.prompt:
12.6 When a neutron changes into a proton then we will observe:
(Jab neutron proton mein badalta hai to hum kya dekhenge?)
blocks.explanation: β⁻-decay mein neutron proton mein badalta hai: ¹₀n → ¹₁p + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄.

blocks.prompt:
12.7 Baryon is formed by combination of:
(Baryon kis ke milap se banta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Baryons (misal proton uud, neutron udd) teen quarks se bante hain; quark-antiquark ka joda meson banata hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.8 Which one of the following forces has negligible effect between the elementary particles:
(In mein se kis force ka elementary particles ke darmiyan asar na hone ke barabar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gravity sab se kamzor force hai (strong force ka taqreeban 10⁻³⁸); subatomic level par is ka asar na hone ke barabar hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.9 Which particles are produced by strong interaction:
(Strong interaction se kaun se particles bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: Strong interaction mein hissa lene wale particles hadrons hain (baryons aur mesons). Mesons sirf hadrons ki ek qism hain, is liye (c) mukammal jawab hai; leptons par strong force asar nahi karti.

blocks.prompt:
12.10 A strong nuclear force exists between the nucleons of:
(Strong nuclear force kin nucleons ke darmiyan hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Strong nuclear force tamam nucleons ko ek jaisa khenchti hai: proton-proton, neutron-neutron aur proton-neutron.

blocks.prompt:
12.11 Which one of the following radiation/particles has the highest ionization power:
(In mein se kis radiation/particle ki ionization power sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: α-particles sab se zyada ionize karte hain: hawa mein taqreeban 10⁴ ion pairs per mm, β ke 10² aur γ ke taqreeban 1 ke muqable mein (Table 12.2).

blocks.prompt:
12.12 Which one of the following radiation/particles has the highest penetrating power
(In mein se kis radiation/particle ki penetrating power (guzar jane ki salahiyat) sab se zyada hai?)
blocks.explanation: γ-rays ki penetrating power sab se zyada hai: inhein rokne ke liye 1-10 cm lead chahiye, jabke α kaghaz se aur β chand mm aluminium se ruk jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.13 A change occurs in atomic member of a nucleus but its mass number remains the same by decay of
(Kis decay mein nucleus ka atomic number badal jata hai lekin mass number wohi rehta hai?)
blocks.explanation: ('atomic member' se murad atomic number hai.) β-decay mein neutron proton ban jata hai (ya proton neutron), is liye Z ek se badal jata hai jabke A wohi rehta hai. α-decay dono badalta hai, γ-decay koi nahi.

blocks.prompt:
12.14 In a nucleus, a neutron changes into a proton the atomic number changes by one, the mass number will be
(Nucleus mein neutron proton mein badle aur atomic number ek se badle, to mass number kya hoga?)
blocks.explanation: β-decay mein koi nucleon kam nahi hota; sirf ek nucleon ki qism badalti hai, is liye mass number A wohi rehta hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.15 The electroweak theory was introduced by:
(Electroweak theory kis ne pesh ki?)
blocks.explanation: Dr. Abdus Salam ne (Weinberg aur Glashow ke saath) electromagnetic aur weak forces ko mila kar electroweak theory banayi aur 1979 ka Nobel Prize hasil kiya (chapter se bahar: chapter electroweak ke carriers W⁺, W⁻ aur Z ka zikr karta hai lekin theory banane walon ka nahi). Dirac ne anti-particles ki peshgoi ki; Anderson ne positron daryaft kiya.

blocks.prompt:
12.16 The asymmetry of matter and antimatter is due to imbalance number of:
(Matter aur antimatter ki na-barabari kis ki tadaad mein adam tawazun (imbalance) ki wajah se hai?)
blocks.explanation: Section 12.9: matter-antimatter ki na-barabari baryon number ke conservation ki khilaf warzi ki wajah se hai, yaani baryons aur anti-baryons ki tadaad barabar nahi.

blocks.prompt:
12.17 Which one of the following particle is responsible for the mass of the fundamental particle:
(In mein se kaun sa particle fundamental particles ke mass ka zimmedar hai?)
blocks.explanation: Particles Higgs field se interact kar ke mass hasil karte hain; is field ka particle Higgs boson 2012 mein CERN mein daryaft hua (Section 12.7).

blocks.prompt:
12.18 A proton is composed of up and down quarks, the order of quarks is:
(Proton up aur down quarks se bana hai; quarks ki tarteeb kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Proton uud hai (do up aur ek down quark): q = 2/3 + 2/3 − 1/3 = +1. udd neutron hai (q = 0). (udu mein bhi wohi quarks hain, lekin proton ko likhne ka mayari tareeqa uud hai.)

blocks.prompt:
12.19 The number of quarks that composed of a neutron is:
(Neutron kitne quarks se bana hai?)
blocks.explanation: Neutron baryon hai jo teen quarks udd se bana hai: q = 2/3 − 1/3 − 1/3 = 0.

blocks.text: Short Answer Questions (mukhtasar jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
12.1 What do different isotopes of a given element have in common? How are they different?
Kisi element ke mukhtalif isotopes mein kya cheez mushtarik (common) hai? Woh kaise mukhtalif hain?
blocks.explanation:
Mushtarik: protons ki tadaad barabar (atomic number Z ek hi), is liye woh ek hi element hain aur chemical symbol bhi ek hai.
Farq: neutrons ki tadaad, is liye mass number A aur mass mukhtalif; kuch stable aur kuch unstable hote hain. Misal: ¹²₆C, ¹³₆C (stable) aur ¹⁴₆C (radioactive).

blocks.prompt:
12.2 Identify the element that has 87 nucleons and 50 neutrons.
Woh element pehchanein jis mein 87 nucleons aur 50 neutrons hain.
blocks.explanation:
A = 87, N = 50
Z = A − N = 87 − 50 = 37
Z = 37 wala element rubidium hai: ⁸⁷₃₇Rb (Z se element pehchanne ke liye periodic table chahiye; chapter se bahar).

blocks.prompt:
12.3 What are the similarities and differences between the strong nuclear force and the electric force?
Strong nuclear force aur electric force mein kya milti julti baatein aur kya farq hain?
blocks.explanation: Milti julti baatein: dono fundamental forces hain, dono protons ke darmiyan amal karti hain, aur dono field particles ke tabadle se muntaqil hoti hain (gluons aur photons). Farq table mein hain.

rows: Bohat chhoti range (< 10⁻¹⁵ m), sirf nucleus ke andar
Tamam nucleons par, charge ho ya na ho (p-p, n-n, p-n)

blocks.prompt:
12.4 Fill in the missing particle or nucleus:
a. ⁴⁵₂₀Ca → ? + e⁻ + ν̄
b. ⁵⁸₂₉Cu* → ? + γ
Ghaib particle ya nucleus likhein.
blocks.explanation:
a. β⁻-decay: A 45 hi rehta hai aur Z ek barh kar 21 (scandium) ho jata hai:
⁴⁵₂₀Ca → ⁴⁵₂₁Sc + e⁻ + ν̄
b. γ-decay: excited (josh wala) nucleus sirf energy chhorta hai, A aur Z wohi rehte hain:
⁵⁸₂₉Cu* → ⁵⁸₂₉Cu + γ
(Z = 21 ko scandium kehna periodic table se hai; chapter se bahar.)

blocks.prompt:
12.5 Why neutrino must be released in the positron emission?
Positron emission mein neutrino ka nikalna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Nikalne wale positrons ki energy har decay mein mukhtalif (continuous) hoti hai, halanke har decay mein nikalne wali total energy fixed hai. Bachi hui energy (aur momentum) neutrino le jata hai, taake energy aur momentum conserve rahein (Pauli ki tajweez, 1930). Yeh lepton number ka hisaab bhi barabar karta hai: positron anti-lepton hai, neutrino lepton.

blocks.prompt:
12.6 Distinguish between fermions and bosons.
Fermions aur bosons mein farq karein.
blocks.explanation: Fermions ka spin aadha (1/2) hota hai aur woh Pauli exclusion principle maante hain; bosons ka spin sifar ya poora number hota hai aur woh yeh principle nahi maante.

rows: Pauli exclusion principle maante hain: ek quantum state mein ek qism ka sirf ek particle
Forces le jane wale (field particles) aur mesons
Misalein: electron, proton, neutron, quarks, neutrinos
Misalein: photon, pion, gluons, W aur Z bosons, Higgs boson

blocks.prompt:
12.7 How does strong force hold the nucleus?
Strong force nucleus ko kaise jore rakhti hai?
blocks.explanation: Nucleus mein protons ek doosre ko electric force se dhakelte hain. Strong nuclear force tamam nucleons (p-p, n-n, p-n) ko ek jaisa khenchti hai aur apni chhoti range (< 10⁻¹⁵ m) mein electric force se taqreeban 100 guna taqatwar hai. Is liye yeh dafa (repulsion) par ghalib aa kar nucleus ko jore rakhti hai. (Yeh quarks ke darmiyan gluons ke zariye amal karti hai.)

blocks.prompt:
12.8 Can there be pair production for photons having energy 20 keV? Explain briefly.
Kya 20 keV energy wale photons se pair production ho sakti hai? Mukhtasar wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Nahi. Pair production ke liye photon ki energy kam az kam pair ki rest mass energy, 2mₒc² = 1.02 MeV, honi chahiye. 20 keV = 0.02 MeV, jo 1.02 MeV se bohat kam hai, is liye electron-positron pair nahi ban sakta.

blocks.prompt:
12.9 What is the difference between beta particle and electron?
Beta particle aur electron mein kya farq hai?
blocks.explanation: β-particle woh electron (ya positron) hai jo nucleus mein ban kar bahar nikalta hai; aam electron nucleus ke bahar chakkar lagata hai. Nikalne ke baad β⁻-particle aur orbital electron mein koi farq nahi kiya ja sakta.

rows: Decay ke waqt nucleus mein banta hai (n → p + e⁻ + ν̄)
Pehle se nucleus ke bahar mojood (orbital electron)
Bohat tez speed se nikalta hai, 0.9995 c tak
Orbit mein bandha hua, bohat kam energy
Manfi (β⁻, electron) ya musbat (β⁺, positron) ho sakta hai
Nuclear radiation hai (ionizing, hawa mein range kai metre)

blocks.prompt:
12.10 How do a proton and a neutron convert to each other?
Proton aur neutron aik doosre mein kaise badalte hain?
blocks.explanation:
Neutron se proton (β⁻-decay): ¹₀n → ¹₁p + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄; quarks mein down quark up quark ban jata hai (udd → uud).
Proton se neutron (β⁺-decay, nucleus ke andar): ¹₁p → ¹₀n + ⁰₊₁e + ν; up quark down quark ban jata hai (uud → udd).
Dono tabdeeliyan weak nuclear force se hoti hain.

blocks.prompt:
12.11 Why does beta-decay have a continuous energy spectrum and alpha-decay have a discrete energy spectrum?
Beta-decay ka energy spectrum continuous aur alpha-decay ka discrete kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation:
α-decay mein sirf do cheezein banti hain (daughter nucleus aur α-particle), is liye fixed energy hamesha ek hi tarah bat'ti hai: har α-particle ki energy ek jaisi (discrete lines).
β-decay mein teen cheezein banti hain (daughter, β-particle aur antineutrino ya neutrino); fixed energy β-particle aur (anti)neutrino mein mukhtalif hisson mein bat'ti hai, is liye β ki energy sifar se maximum tak kuch bhi ho sakti hai (continuous).

blocks.prompt:
12.12 Differentiate between hadron and leptons with examples.
Misalon ke saath hadron aur leptons mein farq karein.
blocks.explanation: Hadrons par strong force asar karti hai aur woh quarks se bane hain; leptons par strong force asar nahi karti aur woh fundamental hain.

rows: Strong nuclear force mehsoos karte hain
Strong force mehsoos nahi karte; sirf weak aur electromagnetic forces
Do giroh: baryons (teen quarks, fermions) aur mesons (quark-antiquark, bosons)
Chhe leptons teen joron mein; sab ka spin 1/2 (fermions)
Misalein: proton, neutron, pion, kaon, lambda
Misalein: electron, muon, tau aur un ke neutrinos

blocks.prompt:
12.13 Why electron-positron pair cannot decay into a single photon?
Electron-positron pair ek akele photon mein kyun nahi badal sakta?
blocks.explanation: Kyunke momentum conserve na hota. Rest par pair ka total momentum sifar hai, jabke akela photon momentum E/c ≠ 0 le jata. Mukhalif simton mein barabar momentum wale do photons total momentum sifar rakhte hain, is liye e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ (har ek 0.51 MeV).

blocks.prompt:
12.14 State the role of Higgs Boson in the generation of mass in modern physics theories.
Modern physics ki theories mein mass paida hone mein Higgs Boson ka kirdar bayan karein.
blocks.explanation: Higgs field poori space mein phaili hui hai; particles is se interact kar ke mass hasil karte hain. Zyada interact karne wale (W⁺, W⁻, Z) ka mass zyada hai, jabke photons interact nahi karte aur un ka rest mass sifar hai. Higgs boson (2012 mein CERN mein daryaft, taqreeban 125 GeV) is field ka particle hai aur is tareeqe ki tasdeeq karta hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.15 What are Mesons? Give example.
Mesons kya hain? Misal dein.
blocks.explanation: Mesons woh hadrons hain jo ek quark aur ek antiquark se bane hain; yeh bosons hain (spin 0 ya poora number). Un ka mass zyada tar electron aur nucleon ke darmiyan hai. Misalein: pions π⁺ (ud̄), π⁰, π⁻ aur kaons (K).

blocks.text: Constructed Response Questions (wazahati jawab wale sawal)

blocks.prompt:
12.1 Why does Beta particle have continuous energy spectrum?
Beta particle ka energy spectrum continuous kyun hota hai?
blocks.explanation: β-decay mein fixed energy nikalti hai, lekin use teen particles mein baantna hota hai: daughter nucleus, β-particle aur antineutrino (ya neutrino). β-particle aur (anti)neutrino ka hissa har decay mein mukhtalif hota hai; un ka majmua hamesha wohi rehta hai. Is liye β-particle ko sifar (jab neutrino taqreeban sab le jaye) se maximum (jab neutrino taqreeban kuch na le) tak koi bhi energy mil sakti hai. β-particles ki tadaad ko kinetic energy ke against plot karein to hamwar curve, yaani continuous spectrum milta hai (Fig. 12.6), jabke α-decay mein tez lakeerein (discrete) hoti hain.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Socho ek fixed raqam (energy) do doston (β-particle aur neutrino) mein har dafa alag tarah bat'ti hai: kabhi pehle ko zyada, kabhi doosre ko. Is liye β-particle ki energy har dafa mukhtalif hoti hai. α-decay mein raqam hamesha ek hi tarah bat'ti hai, is liye energy ek jaisi.

blocks.prompt:
12.2 Is meson or boson or fermion? Give reason.
Meson boson hai ya fermion? Wajah dein.
blocks.explanation: Meson boson hai. Yeh ek quark aur ek antiquark se bana hai, dono ka spin 1/2; mil kar un ka spin poora number (0 ya 1) ban jata hai. Sifar ya poore number spin wale particles Pauli exclusion principle nahi maante aur bosons kehlate hain (Bose-Einstein statistics). Misal: pion ka spin 0 hai. (Mesons hadrons bhi hain, lekin fermions nahi; hadrons mein fermions baryons hain.)

blocks.prompt:
12.3 Why does an alpha emitter emit alpha particles instead of four separate necleons?
Alpha emitter chaar alag alag nucleons ke bajaye alpha particles kyun kharij karta hai?
blocks.explanation:
α-particle (2 protons + 2 neutrons, helium ka nucleus) bohat mazbooti se bandha hua, stable giroh hai: is ke banne se taqreeban 28 MeV binding energy nikalti hai (chapter se bahar). Jab bhaari nucleus bana banaya α-particle kharij karta hai to products ka mass parent se kam hota hai, is liye energy (musbat Q-value) nikalti hai aur decay mumkin hai.
Chaar alag nucleons kharij karne ke liye yeh binding energy bhi deni parti, jo bhaari nucleus ke paas nahi hoti; is liye chaar alag nucleons ka nikalna energy ke lehaaz se namumkin hai. Bhaari nucleus ke andar nucleons α-guchhe (clusters) bhi bana lete hain jo ek hi unit ki tarah nikalte hain.

blocks.prompt:
12.4 Which is more energetic Alpha decay or Beta decay? Justify your answer.
Alpha decay zyada energetic hai ya Beta decay? Apne jawab ka jawaz dein.
blocks.explanation:
Aam tor par alpha decay zyada energetic hai.
1. α-particle β-particle se taqreeban 7300 guna bhaari hai. Table 12.2 ki speeds se: α-particle ki K.E. = 1/2 mv² = 1/2 × 6.64 × 10⁻²⁷ kg × (10⁷ m s⁻¹)² ≈ 3.3 × 10⁻¹³ J ≈ 2 MeV, jabke taqreeban 10⁸ m s⁻¹ (0.33 c) wale β-particle ki sirf taqreeban 0.03 MeV.
2. Har α-particle poori, fixed decay energy le jata hai (aam tor par 4-9 MeV, chapter se bahar), jabke β-particle decay energy ka sirf hissa le jata hai (continuous spectrum), baqi (anti)neutrino le jata hai.
3. Isi liye α-particles hawa mein taqreeban 10⁴ ion pairs per mm banate hain, β ke 10² ke muqable mein. (β-particles tez aur zyada penetrating hain, lekin un ki energy kam hai.)

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Tez hona aur energetic hona ek baat nahi. β-particle tez hai lekin bohat halka; α-particle aahista hai lekin bohat bhaari, is liye K.E. = 1/2 mv² mein α ki energy zyada aati hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.5 A nucleus undergoes Gamma decay, emitting Gamma ray photon with energy 1.5 MeV. Calculate.
(i) frequency of Gamma ray
(ii) wave length of Gamma ray
(iii) momentum of Gamma ray
Ek nucleus gamma decay mein 1.5 MeV energy ka gamma ray photon kharij karta hai. Is ki (i) frequency, (ii) wavelength, (iii) momentum maloom karein.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: E = 1.5 MeV = 1.5 × 10⁶ × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J = 2.4 × 10⁻¹³ J
h = 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s, c = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
(Photon ke formulas E = hf aur p = E/c chapter se bahar hain.)
(i) Frequency:
E = hf, is liye f = E/h
f = 2.4 × 10⁻¹³ J/6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s
f = 3.62 × 10²⁰ Hz
(ii) Wavelength (tool-e-mauj):
λ = c/f
λ = 3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹/3.62 × 10²⁰ Hz
λ = 8.29 × 10⁻¹³ m
(iii) Momentum:
p = E/c (= h/λ)
p = 2.4 × 10⁻¹³ J/3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹
p = 8.0 × 10⁻²² kg m s⁻¹
Jawab: f = 3.62 × 10²⁰ Hz, λ = 8.29 × 10⁻¹³ m, p = 8.0 × 10⁻²² kg m s⁻¹.

blocks.prompt:
12.6 Why does the a-particles not make physical contact with the nucleus when headed directly toward it?
Jab α-particles seedhe nucleus ki taraf jate hain to nucleus ko chhoo kyun nahi pate?
blocks.explanation: α-particle aur nucleus dono musbat charged hain, is liye electric force se ek doosre ko dhakelte hain, aur yeh force qareeb aane par tezi se (1/r² ki tarah) barhti hai. α-particle ki kinetic energy electric potential energy mein badalti jati hai; sab se qareebi fasle par us ki kinetic energy sifar ho jati hai aur woh wapas dhakel diya jata hai. Yeh strong nuclear force ki chhoti range (< 10⁻¹⁵ m) se kafi bahar hota hai, is liye α-particle nucleus ko chhoe baghair laut jata hai (Rutherford ka scattering tajruba; chapter se bahar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein 'a-particles' chhapa hai; is se murad α-particles (alpha particles) hain.

blocks.prompt:
12.1 What is meant by radioactivity? Compare the properties and behavior of three types of radiations.
Radioactivity se kya murad hai? Teen qism ki radiations ki khususiyaat aur rawaiyye ka muqabla karein.
blocks.explanation:
Radioactivity: unstable nuclei ka khud ba khud radiation (α-particles, β-particles aur γ-rays) kharij karna. 82 se zyada atomic number wale nuclei qudrati tor par unstable hain (natural radioactivity); lab mein stable nuclei par neutrons, protons, α-particles ya γ-rays maar kar banaye gaye unstable isotopes artificial radioactivity dikhate hain (radioisotopes).
Electric field mein rawaiyya (Fig. 12.4): α-particles manfi plate ki taraf murte hain (musbat charge), β-particles zyada mur kar musbat plate ki taraf jate hain (manfi aur halke), γ-rays seedhi guzar jati hain (charge nahi).
Khususiyaat ka muqabla table mein hai (Table 12.2).

rows: Nucleus se nikle electrons ya positrons
Manfi plate ki taraf murte hain
Zyada murte hain, musbat plate ki taraf (β⁻)
Ionization (hawa mein ion pairs per mm)

blocks.prompt:
12.2 Elaborate the phenomenon of beta-positive decay and beta-negative decay with examples.
Beta-positive decay aur beta-negative decay ke amal ko misalon ke saath tafseel se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
β-decay nucleus se β-particle (electron ya positron) ka nikalna hai. β-particle orbital electron nahi; yeh nikalte waqt nucleus mein banta hai. Koi nucleon kam nahi hota, is liye A wohi rehta hai jabke Z ek se badalta hai. Yeh weak nuclear force se hota hai.
β⁻ (beta-negative) decay: un nuclides mein jin ka neutron-to-proton ratio zyada ho. Neutron proton, electron aur antineutrino mein badalta hai:
¹₀n → ¹₁p + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄   (quark level: d → u + e⁻ + ν̄)
Aam shakal: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z+1) Y + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄
Misal: ²³⁴₉₀Th → ²³⁴₉₁Pa + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄ (aur ¹⁴₆C → ¹⁴₇N + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄).
β⁺ (beta-positive) decay: un nuclides mein jin ka neutron-to-proton ratio kam ho. Proton neutron, positron aur neutrino mein badalta hai:
¹₁p → ¹₀n + ⁰₊₁e + ν
Aam shakal: ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z−1) Y + ⁰₊₁e + ν
Misal: ¹⁹₁₀Ne → ¹⁹₉F + ⁰₊₁e + ν.
Dono mein nikalne wali energy β-particle aur (anti)neutrino mein bat'ti hai, is liye β-particles ka energy spectrum continuous hai; (anti)neutrino ki tajweez Pauli (1930) ne energy conserve karne ke liye di. Dono ka muqabla table mein hai.

rows: Z ek barhta hai, A wohi
Z ek ghatta hai, A wohi

blocks.prompt:
12.3 What is the difference between matter and antimatter? Discuss reasons why our universe is almost entirely composed of matter.
Matter aur antimatter mein kya farq hai? Wajahein bataein ke hamari kainaat taqreeban poori matter se kyun bani hai.
blocks.explanation:
Antimatter anti-particles se bana hai, jin ka rest mass apne particles jaisa lekin charge ulta hota hai (Dirac ki 1928 ki peshgoi; Anderson ne 1932 mein positron dhoonda). Farq table mein hain.
Kainaat taqreeban poori matter kyun hai:
1. Mushahidaat matter-antimatter ki na-barabari dikhate hain: kainaat mein hydrogen aur helium atoms hain lekin antihydrogen ya antihelium nahi.
2. Tajrubaat ke mutabiq yeh na-barabari baryon number ke conservation ki khilaf warzi se hai, yaani baryons aur anti-baryons ki tadaad barabar nahi.
3. Agar particle-antiparticle symmetry bhi toote to antiquarks se zyada quarks aur antileptons se zyada leptons banne ka raasta mil jata hai, aur aakhir mein antimatter se zyada matter.
4. Jahan matter aur antimatter mile woh annihilate ho kar radiation ban gaye; matter ki thori si ziyadati bach gayi aur wohi hamari kainaat hai (chapter se bahar).
Is na-barabari ki asal wajah ab bhi ek raaz hai.

rows: Particles se bana: electrons, protons, neutrons (quarks aur leptons)
Anti-particles se bana: positrons, anti-protons, anti-neutrons (antiquarks aur antileptons)
Mass wohi lekin charge ulta (positron +e, anti-proton −e)
Baghair bar ke likha jata hai: p, ν
Aam tor par bar ke saath: p̄, ν̄
Taqreeban poori nazar aane wali kainaat
Bohat kam; cosmic rays aur accelerators mein banta hai
Antimatter se mil kar energy (γ-rays) ban jata hai
Matter se mil kar energy (γ-rays) ban jata hai

blocks.prompt:
12.4 Explain the phenomenon of pair annihilation with an example. Explain the utility of its principle in the medical field.
Pair annihilation ke amal ko misal ke saath samjhaein. Medical field mein is ke usool ka faida bataein.
blocks.explanation:
Pair annihilation pair production ka ulat hai: jab particle apne anti-particle se milta hai to dono khatam ho jate hain aur un ka mass E = mc² ke mutabiq energy (γ-ray photons) ban jata hai.
Misal: e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ
Taqreeban rest par electron aur positron se 0.51 MeV ke do γ-photons (total 1.02 MeV = 2mₒc²) mukhalif simton mein nikalte hain. Charge (−e + e = 0), energy aur momentum conserve rehte hain; total momentum sifar rakhne ke liye do photons zaroori hain. Doosre jore bhi annihilate hote hain: proton aur antiproton, quark aur antiquark.
Medical istemal: PET (positron emission tomography) scan (chapter se bahar):
1. Mareez ko positron kharij karne wala radioactive tracer (misal fluorine-18 wala glucose) injection se diya jata hai.
2. Har positron jism mein jald kisi electron se mil kar 0.51 MeV ke do γ-photons ban jata hai jo mukhalif simton mein jate hain.
3. Mareez ke gird detectors ka daira photons ke joron ko ek hi waqt mein pakarta hai; computer har annihilation ki lakeer maloom kar ke 3D tasveer banata hai.
4. Zyada active tissues zyada tracer lete hain, is liye PET metabolism dikhata hai: cancer aur us ka phailao, dimagh ki bimariyan aur dil ke masail pakarta hai.

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Do photons hamesha bilkul ulti simton mein jate hain; is liye detector ke daire par aamne saamne do jagah ek saath signal aata hai. In do points ko milane wali lakeer par hi annihilation hua tha. Hazaron aisi lakeerein mil kar tasveer bana deti hain.

blocks.prompt:
12.5 Explain the law of conservation of energy and momentum in electron-positron pair annihilation.
Electron-positron pair annihilation mein energy aur momentum ke conservation ke qanoon ki wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: e⁻ + e⁺ → γ + γ
Energy ka conservation: pehle ki total energy (rest mass energies aur kinetic energies) baad mein photons ki total energy ke barabar hai:
mₒc² + mₒc² + K.E. = E₁ + E₂
Taqreeban rest par pair ke liye: E₁ + E₂ = 2mₒc² = 1.02 MeV, yaani har photon ki E = mₒc² = 0.51 MeV.
Momentum ka conservation: rest par pair ka pehle total momentum sifar hai, is liye photons ka total momentum bhi sifar hona chahiye. Akela photon hamesha momentum (p = E/c) rakhta hai, is liye ek photon namumkin hai. Barabar energy ke do photons ulti simton mein jayen to un ke momentum barabar aur ulte hain: p₁ + p₂ = 0. Isi liye kam az kam do photons bante hain.
Charge bhi conserve hai: (−e) + (+e) = 0 = photons ka charge.

blocks.prompt:
12.6 Describe protons and neutrons in terms of their quark composition.
Protons aur neutrons ko un ki quark banawat ke lehaaz se bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Protons aur neutrons baryons (hadrons) hain, har ek do sab se halke flavours ke teen quarks se bana hai: up quark u (charge +2/3) aur down quark d (charge −1/3).
Proton = uud: q = 2/3 + 2/3 + (−1/3) = +1
Neutron = udd: q = 2/3 + (−1/3) + (−1/3) = 0
Har baryon mein har colour (red, green, blue) ka ek quark hai, is liye woh colourless hai. Quarks strong (colour) force se jure hain jo gluons le jate hain (quantum chromodynamics). Quarks kabhi akele nazar nahi aate.
Quark model β-decay bhi samjhata hai: jab down quark up quark ban jata hai (d → u + e⁻ + ν̄) to neutron (udd) proton (uud) ban jata hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.7 Describe four fundamental forces in nature.
Fitrat ki chaar fundamental forces bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
Kainaat ke tamam interactions chaar fundamental forces chalati hain:
1. Gravitational force: sab se kamzor (strong force ka taqreeban 10⁻³⁸) lekin range la-mehdood; hamesha attractive; masses ke hasil-e-zarb ke mutanasib aur fasle ke murabba ke ulat mutanasib. Bhaari ajsaam (Sooraj, sayyare) ke liye aham, atomic particles ke darmiyan na hone ke barabar. Carrier: graviton.
2. Electromagnetic force: charged particles ke darmiyan; attractive ya repulsive; inverse square law; strong force ka taqreeban 10⁻², range la-mehdood. Atom ki banawat, chemical bonding, bijli, magnetism aur roshni ise se hain. Maxwell (1861) ne bijli aur magnetism ko mila diya. Carrier: photon.
3. Weak nuclear force: strong force ka taqreeban 10⁻¹³, range < 10⁻¹⁸ m. Radioactive β-decay aur neutrino interactions ki zimmedar; particles ki pehchan badal sakti hai (n ↔ p), sitaron mein fusion ke liye zaroori. Carriers: W⁺, W⁻ aur Z bosons.
4. Strong nuclear force: sab se taqatwar (relative strength 1), chhoti range (< 10⁻¹⁵ m), sirf nucleus ke andar; tamam nucleons ko ek jaisa khenchti hai aur protons ki dafa par ghalib aa kar nucleus ko jore rakhti hai. Carrier: gluons.

blocks.prompt:
12.8 Describe the classification of elementary particles.
Elementary particles ki darja bandi (classification) bayan karein.
blocks.explanation:
1. Spin ke lehaaz se:
Fermions: spin 1/2, Pauli exclusion principle maante hain (electrons, protons, neutrons, quarks, leptons).
Bosons: spin sifar ya poora number, yeh principle nahi maante (photon spin 1, pions spin 0, gluons, W, Z, Higgs).
2. Kaun si force mehsoos karte hain:
Hadrons: strong force mehsoos karte hain; quarks se bane. Do qismein:
   Baryons (bhaari): teen quarks; fermions; misal proton (uud), neutron (udd), lambda (Λ⁰), sigma, omega.
   Mesons (darmiyani mass): ek quark aur ek antiquark; bosons; misal pions (π⁺ = ud̄), kaons.
Leptons (halke): strong force mehsoos nahi karte; fundamental, spin 1/2; chhe leptons teen joron mein: electron aur electron neutrino, muon aur muon neutrino, tau aur tau neutrino, har ek ka anti-particle bhi.
3. Fundamental particles (standard model):
Quarks: chhe flavours, up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom, kasri charge ke saath (+2/3 ya −1/3).
Leptons: upar wale chhe leptons.
Bosons (force carriers): photon (electromagnetic), gluons (strong), W⁺, W⁻, Z (weak), gravity ke liye graviton (abhi dekha nahi gaya), aur Higgs boson jo batata hai ke particles ko mass kaise milta hai.
Har particle ka anti-particle hai. Matter (kainaat ka 5%) quarks aur leptons se bana hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.1 Uranium-238 is an alpha emitter. In the process, it is transmuted into a daughter nucleus. What is the mass number (A) and charge number (Z) of the daughter nucleus? What is its chemical symbol? (Ans: A-234, Z=90, Thorium)
Uranium-238 alpha kharij karta hai aur daughter nucleus mein badal jata hai. Daughter nucleus ka mass number (A) aur charge number (Z) kya hai? Is ka chemical symbol kya hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: parent ²³⁸₉₂U (Z = 92), alpha decay
Maloom karna: daughter ka A aur Z, us ka symbol
α-decay mein: A 4 kam aur Z 2 kam hota hai (ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ⁻⁴_(Z−2) Y + ⁴₂He)
A = 238 − 4 = 234
Z = 92 − 2 = 90
²³⁸₉₂U → ²³⁴₉₀Th + ⁴₂He
Jawab: A = 234, Z = 90; daughter thorium hai, ²³⁴₉₀Th (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.prompt:
12.2 Polonium ²¹⁸₈₄Po is a beta minus emitter. What will be the mass number (A) and charge number (Z) of the daughter nucleus? (Ans: A = 218, Z = 85)
Polonium ²¹⁸₈₄Po beta minus kharij karta hai. Daughter nucleus ka mass number (A) aur charge number (Z) kya hoga?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: parent ²¹⁸₈₄Po, β⁻ decay
Maloom karna: daughter ka A aur Z
β⁻-decay mein: A wohi rehta hai aur Z 1 barhta hai (ᴬ_Z X → ᴬ_(Z+1) Y + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄)
A = 218
Z = 84 + 1 = 85
²¹⁸₈₄Po → ²¹⁸₈₅At + ⁰₋₁e + ν̄
Jawab: A = 218, Z = 85 (astatine, At; element ka naam chapter se bahar hai). Kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai.

blocks.prompt:
12.3 Nitrogen ¹⁴₇N bombarded by alpha particle results into ¹⁷₈O. What is the product particle in this nuclear reaction? (Ans: ¹₁H proton)
Nitrogen ¹⁴₇N par alpha particle maarne se ¹⁷₈O banta hai. Is nuclear reaction mein doosra banne wala particle kaun sa hai?
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: ¹⁴₇N + ⁴₂He → ¹⁷₈O + ᴬ_Z X
Maloom karna: banne wala particle X
Nucleon number: 14 + 4 = 17 + A, is liye A = 18 − 17 = 1
Charge number: 7 + 2 = 8 + Z, is liye Z = 9 − 8 = 1
A = 1 aur Z = 1 wala particle proton hai, ¹₁H.
¹⁴₇N + ⁴₂He → ¹⁷₈O + ¹₁H
Jawab: banne wala particle proton, ¹₁H, hai (kitab ka jawab bhi yahi hai).

blocks.prompt:
12.4 Show that nucleon number (N) and charge number (Z) are conserved in the numerical question 12.3.
Sabit karein ke numerical sawal 12.3 mein nucleon number (N) aur charge number (Z) conserve rehte hain.
blocks.explanation:
Reaction: ¹⁴₇N + ⁴₂He → ¹⁷₈O + ¹₁H
Nucleon number:
Pehle: 14 + 4 = 18
Baad mein: 17 + 1 = 18
18 = 18, is liye nucleon number conserve hai.
Charge number:
Pehle: 7 + 2 = 9
Baad mein: 8 + 1 = 9
9 = 9, is liye charge number conserve hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal nucleon number ko N kehta hai. Kitab ki apni Eq. 12.1 ke mutabiq N neutron number hai aur nucleon (mass) number A hai; conserve hone wali cheezein nucleon number A aur charge number Z hain.

blocks.prompt:
12.5 Determine the rest mass energy of electron in eV. Its rest mass is 0.0000555 u? (Ans: 0.51 MeV)
Electron ki rest mass energy eV mein maloom karein. Is ka rest mass 0.0000555 u hai.
blocks.explanation:
Diya gaya: electron ka rest mass mₒ = 0.00055 u (Section 12.1; chhapa hua 0.0000555 u mein ek zero zyada hai, neeche dekhein)
1 u = 931 MeV (Section 12.1)
Maloom karna: rest mass energy Eₒ eV mein
Eₒ = mₒc² = 0.00055 u × 931 MeV/u
Eₒ = 0.512 MeV
Eₒ = 5.1 × 10⁵ eV ≈ 0.51 MeV
SI units mein check: mₒ = 0.00055 × 1.6606 × 10⁻²⁷ kg = 9.13 × 10⁻³¹ kg
Eₒ = 9.13 × 10⁻³¹ kg × (3 × 10⁸ m s⁻¹)² = 8.22 × 10⁻¹⁴ J
Eₒ = 8.22 × 10⁻¹⁴ J/1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ J eV⁻¹ = 5.1 × 10⁵ eV
Jawab: Eₒ = 5.1 × 10⁵ eV = 0.51 MeV (kitab ka jawab).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Sawal mein electron ka rest mass 0.0000555 u chhapa hai. Is se sirf 0.0000555 × 931 MeV = 0.0517 MeV (5.17 × 10⁴ eV) milti hai, kitab ka jawab 0.51 MeV nahi. Electron ka rest mass 0.00055 u hai (Section 12.1; zyada durust 0.000549 u), jis se 0.51 MeV milta hai; chhape hue number mein ek zero zyada hai.

items: Numerical 12.1, 12.2, 12.3 ke jawab kitab se milte hain; 12.5 mein electron ka mass ghalat chhapa hai (0.0000555 u ke bajaye 0.00055 u), "Kitab ki ghalti" box dekhein.
Short, constructed aur comprehensive sawalon ke model jawab upar har sawal ke saath hain.
